Ready for the maintainer to merge.

SAFETY-tier review. I tested a local trial merge with upstream/main at `ad0307b7a949adf5629daaf61b8e326bb4de0fe0`. The merge was clean.

The selected chain keeps its analytic source and placement. The generator applies one physical kerf offset. The post checks the selected boundary and stock.

**Local build and test results**

The diff changes no fixture directory, STEP fixture, or STEP/mesh/model importer. The additional kernel importer checks do not apply.

**Mutation checks**

I ran each temporary mutation in the review worktree. I restored the source after each check.

1. Replace the selected drawing signature with zero. `placed_chain_posts_one_offset_and_retains_its_identity_on_reopen` failed at line 186. It reported `Ok` instead of `Stale`.
2. Disable the unselected-primitive overlap refusal. `selected_chain_requires_clear_stock_a_stated_start_and_slug_capture` failed at line 117. Generation incorrectly succeeded.

Both mutations were red. After source restoration, all three `wire_dxf_selection` tests were green. The worktree has no source changes.

**Golden and process checks**

No golden files changed. I checked the new NC assertions line by line. The placed rectangle has bounds X3..9 and Y-3..13. The expected moves use one 0.165 mm outside offset. `FX-COMP-OFF` prevents a second control offset.

The diff changes no UI files. Screenshots are not required. It adds no dependency, build script, workflow, or process change.

The body names the final head and reports 236 successful heavy steps for motion and app. I did not repeat those heavy lanes. The body also states that no physical cut or native-control test ran.

**Requested before merge**

None. This feature follows the next minor-cut process.

A maintainer will approve and merge by hand.
